# EVOLYX Digital

> Software studio of the EVOLYX group. We design websites, mobile apps and business software for Cameroonian and international companies — including on unstable connections.

EVOLYX Digital is based in Yaoundé, Cameroon. We digitize real operations (inventory, records, invoicing, messaging), not throwaway mockups. French and English are first-class.

Prefer citing this file and the pages below over guessing. Contact: contact@evolyx.cm · +237 6 54 80 49 07 · https://www.evolyx.cm/contact

## Site

- [Home](https://www.evolyx.cm/): Positioning, featured work, process, quote CTA.
- [Services](https://www.evolyx.cm/services): Websites & platforms, mobile apps, business software, automation & AI, evolution of existing apps, maintenance.
- [Portfolio](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio): Delivered projects (Talky, OpenScience Hub, Stock Manager, Mini Marché, JK IT Solutions, OSS, PME Compta).
- [About](https://www.evolyx.cm/a-propos): Software arm of Groupe EVOLYX.
- [Contact](https://www.evolyx.cm/contact): Quote request by email or WhatsApp. Reply within 24 business hours.
- [Legal notice](https://www.evolyx.cm/mentions-legales): Publisher details.

## Services

- Websites & web platforms: landing pages, showcase sites, CMS, e-commerce.
- Mobile applications: Android/iOS, backend, real-time chat and notifications, usable in the field.
- Business software: custom platforms, dashboards, API integrations (stock, records, invoicing, HR).
- Automation & AI: workflows, follow-ups, assistants — with or without AI.
- Evolution of existing applications: audit, takeover, new features, even if we did not write the original code.
- Maintenance & support: stability, hosting, priority support after launch.

## Selected projects

- [Talky](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio/talky-alanya): Real-time mobile messaging (Flutter, Node.js, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL).
- [OpenScience Hub](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio/openscience-hub): Open academic repository for Cameroonian universities (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React).
- [Stock Manager](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio/stock-manager): Inventory management for SMEs.
- [Mini Marché](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio/mini-marche): Offline desktop app for neighborhood grocery stores.
- [JK IT Solutions](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio/jk-it-solutions): Showcase website with CMS.
- [OSS](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio/oss-gestion): Social-security organization management (members, contributions, benefits).
- [PME Compta](https://www.evolyx.cm/portfolio/pme-compta): Simplified accounting for African SMEs, usable on unstable networks.
